Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 6187 -1971 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
SAW, WIRE (GIGLI PATTERN) 



( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 



1. Scope — Dimensions and other requirements for Gigli pattern wire saw of sizes 30, 40^ 50, 60 and 
70 cm. 

2. Materials 

2.1 Main Wire — Conforming to Grade 1 of Section 11 of IS : 4454-1967 ' Specification for steel wires 
for cold formed springs '. 

2.2 Cross Wire— Conforming to Grade 3 of Section II of IS : 4454-1967. 

2.3 Loop Wire — Conforming to Grade 1 of Section II of IS : 4454-1967. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 

LOOP WIRE, 0*6 DIA 




L =» 300, 400, 500, 600 and 700 

All dimensions in miliimetres. 

FIG. 1 WIRE SAW. GIGLI PATTERN 

4. Workmanship — Winding of cross wire over main wire and intertwining of main wires shall be 
uniform and maintained at pitches given in Fig. 1. The loop wire shall be interwoven at each end with 
the main wires and soldered with tin- lead solder conforming to Grade Sn 65 of IS : 193-1966 ' Speci- 
fication for soft solder ( second revision ) '. Soldering shall be done carefully so as not to weaken the 
loop ends. 

5. Finish — The wire saw shall be chromium-plated to give a minimum thiclcness of 0*3 [xm. 

6. Performance Test — The wire saw shall cut a piece of fresh sheep bone of at least 10 mm 
thickness without sticking or slipping. After the test the wire saw shall not show any sign of 
damage. 

7. Packing and Marking — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. However, it is 
recommended that the wire saws should be packed individually in transparent polyethylene bags and 
each bag should contain a label marked with the length of the wire saw, manufacturer's name and 
country of origin. 

7.1 ISI Certification MarA/ng— Details available from the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1. 



Adopted 26 July 1971
